title: cutting drain bowl board
text: cutting drain bowl board. I was skeptical I would like this drain cutting bowl board - but so far, I love it.  The drain stays plugged and solid (no leaking) while you're soaking or other and a simple, firm press opens the valve for quick draining.  The bowl then collapses into a fair sized cutting board.  The collapsible aspect makes this very easy to store flat.  I am curious to see how it will stand the test of time.  Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
